name: fresher_projects_only
description: The case that was entirely broken before projects were scored or rewritten: a new grad whose only technical evidence lives in Projects.
jd_text:
Junior Data Engineer

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain ETL pipelines
- Work with the analytics team to model data for reporting
- Automate data quality checks

Requirements:
- Familiarity with Python and SQL
- Exposure to cloud data warehouses
- Understanding of data pipeline concepts

Nice to have:
- Apache Airflow
- dbt

resume_content.objective: Recent computer science graduate seeking a data engineering role.

projects.name: Campus Course Analytics
bullets: Built a pipeline pulling course enrolment data from three campus systems into a single warehouse
Scheduled nightly refreshes with Airflow and added checks that flagged malformed records
Created a dashboard that 200 students used to compare course workloads

projects.name: Transit Delay Tracker
bullets: Collected live bus arrival data over 6 months and stored it in PostgreSQL
Wrote SQL models that surfaced the 10 most delay-prone routes in the city
